dropped.t: The Company expects to submit an Investigational New Drug (IND) application in the first half of 2027.

risks.t: the delay of any current and future nonclinical studies or clinical trials or the development of Avalo’s product candidates
the timing and outcome of any interactions with regulatory authorities
obtaining, maintaining and protecting Avalo’s intellectual property
the availability of funding sufficient for Avalo’s operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements, reliance on key personnel
general economic and market risks and uncertainties, including those caused by the war in Ukraine and the Middle East
those other risks detailed in Avalo’s filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, available at www.sec.gov
